subject: POC success criteria & next steps (Atlas Payments)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@atlas-payments.com>, Amit Shah <amit.shah@atlas-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC success criteria & next steps (Atlas Payments)

Hi Sofia / Amit - thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we spin up the trial environment. Please reply with any adjustments.

Summary of agreed scope:
- Redwood will run a 4-week POC focused on payment-auth use cases (tokenization and fraud scoring inference paths).
- Redwood provides a test harness + synthetic load and replay capability; Atlas will supply representative request samples and acceptance prompts.

Draft success criteria / KPIs (please confirm):
1) Latency: p95 generation latency under 150 - 200 ms for short auth requests (we heard 150ms target from you; proposing p95 < 200ms as initial SLO, can tighten to 150ms for paid Dedicated).
2) Throughput: sustain 200 QPS with 95% of requests meeting latency SLO during peak replay.
3) Cost: average cost <= $0.001 / token for steady-state inference (we'll provide cost breakdown by quant/profile).
4) Quality: human-eval accuracy >= 92% on a seeded test set (~200 prompts); pass rate on critical intents >= 98%.
5) Reliability: no more than one P99 outage >1s during the test window; full request traceability (request id -> model response).

Proposed timeline and ownership:
- Week 0 (this week): sign SOW/POC addendum & share test payloads - Owners: Atlas (Sofia/Amit), Redwood (Jordan).
- Week 1: infra setup & integration (VPC routing, keys) - Owners: Atlas infra + Redwood infra.
- Week 2: functional testing & quality evaluation (human evals + automated queries) - Owners: Atlas QA + Marissa (CS).
- Week 3: load tests & latency tuning - Owners: Redwood engineering + Atlas infra.
- Week 4: final acceptance, results review, and decision (go/no-go) - Owners: product + procurement.

Attachments: I attached the draft test plan and a latency KPI template (CSV) so you can drop in sample payloads.

Next steps: can you confirm the KPIs above and provide the list of top 200 intents/queries you want included in the human eval? Also confirm a target start date (we suggested Aug 22 on the call).

Thanks - happy to jump on a 30-min follow-up to lock details.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0124

From: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@atlas-payments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit.shah@atlas-payments.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC success criteria & next steps (Atlas Payments)

Thanks Jordan - this is helpful and mostly aligned. A couple of notes from our side: 
- Latency: we'd like to target p95 < 150ms for auth paths if possible. If 150ms is only achievable on Dedicated, flag that and we'll discuss cost tradeoffs.
- Quality: 200 prompts sounds right; we'll prioritize the critical intents and share them by EOD Tuesday.
- Security: procurement will need a quick SOC 2 artifact check before we begin. Can Marissa send the standard evidence bundle?

We can target Aug 22 as a start date but need procurement to sign the SOW - I looped Amit who will coordinate PO timing.

- Sofia
Sofia Ramirez
Head of Payments Engineering | Atlas Payments
sofia.ramirez@atlas-payments.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@atlas-payments.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC success criteria & next steps (Atlas Payments)

Hi Sofia - copying the CS/test plan details below and attaching the draft test plan + latency CSV for your team to populate. Quick clarifications: 
- Test harness: we will run both synthetic (scale) and replay (real traffic) tests. For replay please provide sanitized logs (PII removed).
- Latency measurement: we'll use p50/p90/p95/p99 and include measured token counts; the CSV has example rows.
- Quality eval: we'll run a blind human-eval on ~200 labeled prompts; please indicate which intents are critical so we can weight pass/fail.

Attachments included: Atlas_POC_testplan_v1.pdf (draft test plan), latency_kpi_sheet.csv (template).

I'll also include a short SOC 2 evidence checklist and can share the standard bundle once we have a non-disclosure waiver in place.

Thanks - Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@atlas-payments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC success criteria & next steps (Atlas Payments)

Jordan / Marissa - couple quick infra questions from my side: 
1) Regional routing: can Redwood route requests to our EU region for a subset of tests? We need to validate regional latency and data residency behavior.
2) Capacity planning: do you have an estimate of the GPU footprint / concurrency we should reserve for 200 QPS? (ballpark is fine).
3) Cost estimate: besides the per-token target, what are expected infra/egress costs during heavy replay tests?

Also - procurement asks for a one-page SOW and PO number template. I've uploaded a stub to our procurement doc; Jordan, can you confirm you can accept a PO and sign the SOW by next week?

Regards,
Amit Shah
Director of Infrastructure | Atlas Payments
amit.shah@atlas-payments.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@atlas-payments.com>, Amit Shah <amit.shah@atlas-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC success criteria & next steps (Atlas Payments)

Thanks everyone - quick replies inline and next steps.

Amit - yes we can route a subset of traffic to EU; we'll coordinate region-specific endpoints and you'll get separate traces for residency validation. For the 200 QPS target our engineering estimates put the initial play at ~2 x A100-class instances for steady concurrency with headroom (we'll refine after we ingest sample payloads). We'll include expected egress/infra estimates in the onboarding doc - Marissa will follow up.

Sofia - noted on the 150ms preference. I flagged 150ms as the aspirational SLO; we'll start the POC with p95 < 200ms as the baseline and work to optimize toward 150ms. If you prefer to set 150ms as the contractual acceptance threshold we should discuss Dedicated/quantization tradeoffs in the SOW.

Procurement / SOW: I uploaded the one-page SOW and triggered a DocuSign link here: https://app.docusign.com/POC-ATL-4521. HubSpot deal updated: hubspot:deal/4521.

Next meeting: propose Tue Aug 17, 30-min to finalize SOW and confirm sample payloads. Confirmed start date: Aug 22 conditional on PO/SOW.

Action items:
- Atlas: share top 200 prompts and sanitized replay logs (Sofia/Amit) - due Aug 17.
- Redwood: share SOC2 evidence bundle + finalized test plan (Marissa) - due Aug 16.
- Redwood: provide refined capacity/cost estimate after sample payloads received (Jordan/Engineering) - due Aug 19.

I'll attach the draft test plan and KPI CSV here for your convenience.

Best,
Jordan
